mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account ( customer_id, account_no, status, opened_at, created_at, limit_amount, amount, benefit ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, NULL, 'APPLIED', NULL, #{createdAt}, #{limitAmount}, 0, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = 'APPLIED', limit_amount = #{limitAmount} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'REJECTED' AND account_no IS NULL AND opened_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ke.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' THEN ke.final_amount WHEN ke.exchange_id IS NOT NULL THEN ke.provisional_amount ELSE so.sell_qty * so.base_price END ), 0) FROM sell_order so INNER JOIN inbound_detail ind ON ind.inbound_detail_id = so.inbound_detail_id INNER JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = ind.inbound_id LEFT JOIN krw_exchange ke ON ke.order_id = so.order_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND so.status IN ('RECEIVED', 'EXECUTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = 'REJECTED' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'APPLIED' AND account_no IS NULL AND opened_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account ORDER BY customer_id desc
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = 'OPENED', account_no = #{accountNo}, opened_at = #{openedAt} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'REJECTED' AND account_no IS NULL AND opened_at IS NULL
UPDATE account SET benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND benefit IN('POSSIBLE','REDUCED')
mapper.select: SELECT ci_hash FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE status IN ('APPLIED', 'CLOSURE_REQUESTED')

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, a.status AS status, a.limit_amount AS limitAmount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ke.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' THEN ke.final_amount WHEN ke.exchange_id IS NOT NULL THEN ke.provisional_amount ELSE so.sell_qty * so.base_price END ), 0) AS usedAmount FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON so.account_id = a.account_id AND so.status IN ('RECEIVED', 'EXECUTED') LEFT JOIN krw_exchange ke ON ke.order_id = so.order_id WHERE a.status = 'OPENED' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_no, c.name, a.status, a.limit_amount

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, a.status AS status, a.limit_amount AS limitAmount, 0 AS usedAmount FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.status = 'APPLIED'
